entries.title: A card keeps your picks when Infinitary restarts
entries.body: If you pick answers on a card and Infinitary restarts before you choose, after an update for example, the card now comes back with your picks. This includes a card you put aside. They stay on this computer until the card closes. Words typed in the card's own message box are still cleared by a restart.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen looks different: the card comes back with the picks you made before the restart instead of empty.
